notes.title: OMG!? Toasty’s Making an Even Darker Game: "Grimdelve"
notes.notes:
[h1] BRAND NEW TOASTY GAME IN DEVELOPMENT! [/h1]

We're closing in on 5 years since Aimi was released, I bet you all thought I had vanished from the game dev scene... BUT NO! I took a break, played Fear and Hunger, Disco Elysium, and Underrail, and realized I wanted to make another game. So, emerging from the caverns of my mind is "Grimdelve".

Check it out here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616480/Grimdelve/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616480/Grimdelve/[/url]

Aimi had a number of imperfections, but on the whole I'm proud of what I did with it (sorry about the roman numerals puzzle though... my bad on that one). I have taken what I learned from this game and already Grimdelve is shaping up to be MUCH better. So, if you at all enjoyed what I cooked with Aimi, consider checking out Grimdelve and giving it a wishlist. It helps me a ton!

I do also want to take a second here, since I haven't posted much on the discussion forums before, to thank all of you for taking time out of your lives to give Aimi a chance. It's a very important game to me and I hope each of you found something to enjoy about it. There's a lot I would have done differently, but I'm going to take all of the feedback I received in the reviews for Aimi and apply that to Grimdelve. I want to keep making very human stories that mean something to the people that play them. I love game development and I hope to deliver an even better experience this time around. 

Thank you and have an amazing day!

notes.title: Encrypting Aimi's Files
notes.notes:
Hello there, this is the developer of Aimi! The creators of the art pack used in this game recently contacted me and required me to encrypt the games files so they can't as easily be stolen. If you see Aimi requires an update, this is why. Hopefully it doesn't mess up your saves, but if it does I am truly sorry. You can always contact me at: toasty.rpgtime@gmail.com and I can try to resolve your issue to the best of my abilities, but I won't be able to fix everything.

Thank you for playing!
